programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep02
programme.desc: The revived Tamagawa Dodgeball Club's first opponent is the Saint Arrows Dodgeball Club, led by Peiko, Danko's destined rival. Defeat is not an option, so the team begins intense training!

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep03
programme.desc: The battle between the two teams heats up with only Danko and Honey left on the court. Just as Honey is driven into a corner, she finally awakens her true potential!? Which team will win?

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep04
programme.desc: Honey is out due to injuries, and the match between Danko and Peiko finally takes place. When Danko's signature move proves ineffective against Peiko, something begins to stir inside her...

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep05
programme.desc: Danko and Peiko clash in an epic final battle, ending in mutual respect. Though Saint Arrows wins, the club faces disbandment-until two girls arrive claiming to be its rightful members.

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep06
programme.desc: With new members Hako and Hayami, the Tamagawa Dodgeball Club is officially formed! The team attends a training camp at the beach in preparation for a secret dodgeball championship.

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep07

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep08
programme.desc: The Tosa Attackers are defeated by the Black Armors captain, Ran. Meanwhile, Danko's team now face the powerful US Buffaloes, who believe the United States is the best in dodgeball.

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep09

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep10

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep11
programme.desc: With only two players on each side left on the field, Chinko and Satsuki clash as Ran unleashes her dark power. Danko and Ran prepare for a final showdown rooted in their fathers' rivalry.

programme.title: Flaming Dodgeball Girl Danko Ep12

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp

programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lung's adventures in Jiang Nan.

programme.title: Notorious Eight

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: A young woman's life turns tragic after she discovers that she's adopted and then goes in search of her real mother.

programme.title: 7-Man Army

programme.title: Rear Entrance
